jobs.occupation: Advance Your Career as a Consultant Pathologist in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a specialist in pathology looking for a role where you can combine advanced diagnostics with a balanced lifestyle?
We are currently seeking specialist surgical pathologists to join a modern and accredited department in central Sweden, located in a region known for its coastal setting, rich history, and strong connection to nature.
About the Department
The surgical pathology and cytology unit plays a central role in diagnostics by analyzing tissue and cell samples using both microscopy and advanced digital systems. The goal is to provide accurate and timely diagnostic support to clinicians, improving patient outcomes and safety.
The department is part of a larger organization within laboratory medicine and is at the forefront of digital pathology, with ongoing development in automation, robotics, and AI-driven diagnostics.
In addition to histopathology and cytology, the unit is also responsible for:
Gynecological screening programs
Autopsy services and morgue operations
Multidisciplinary clinical conferences
You will work in a collaborative and well-structured environment with experienced colleagues across multiple disciplines.
Your role
As a specialist surgical pathologist, your work will include:
Diagnostic work in histopathology and cytology
Gross examination and specimen handling
Participation in clinical conferences and interdisciplinary discussions
Autopsy
Supervising and mentoring residents

Daytime on-call service for urgent diagnostic cases is shared within the team.
Qualifications
EU-recognized specialist certification in pathology
Experience in surgical pathology
Strong communication skills in English and a willingness to learn Swedish
Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-based environment
A structured, collaborative, and flexible approach

Why work here?
This opportunity is located in a coastal region of central Sweden, offering a unique mix of professional development and quality of life. The area is known for:
Easy access to the sea, forests, and outdoor activities year-round
A rich industrial and cultural heritage
A safe and family-friendly environment
Good infrastructure with connections to larger cities
The working environment is modern, forward-thinking, and continuously evolving, providing excellent conditions for both professional growth and long-term career development.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype
Take the next step in your career
This is an excellent opportunity for surgical pathologists who want to work in a progressive environment while enjoying a high quality of life.
Ready to Take the Next Step in Your Career?
Don’t hesitate to contact me. I look forward to hearing from you and helping you find the perfect job that matches your experience and ambitions.
Apply now!

jobs.occupation: General nurses wanted for permanent positions in Norway
jobs.description:
Are you a qualified general nurse looking for professional growth and new life experiences?
We offer numerous exciting opportunities for nurses who are interested in moving to Norway, a country known for its high-quality healthcare system, balanced work-life culture and beautiful natural landscapes.
Your role:
Providing holistic care to patients, addressing their medical, hygienic and social needs.
Monitoring patients’ vital signs and keeping records of their health progress.
Administering medications and treatments as prescribed by doctors.
Performing blood draws and other routine medical procedures.
Collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to deliver optimal care.
Offering emotional support and clear communication to patients and their families.
Working in both hospital and home care settings, adapting to each patient’s individual needs.

Qualifications:
Hold a valid nursing authorization from an EU country.
Have previous work experience as a nurse, with a preference for those who have experience in hospitals or community care settings.
Be proficient with basic computer skills, necessary for modern healthcare environments.
Speak and write English fluently. Candidates must also be motivated to learn Norwegian.
Hold a bachelor’s degree in nursing (BSN).
A driver’s license may be required for certain home care positions.

Personal qualities:
Strong communication skills and the ability to work well in a team-oriented environment.
A responsible, structured, and flexible approach to patient care.
The ability to remain calm and perform under pressure, handling stressful situations with a professional attitude.
Respect for patients’ individual needs and a compassionate approach to their care.
A strong desire to move to Norway and integrate into Norwegian society, bringing your family along for a rewarding experience.
A genuine passion for nursing, combined with a clear understanding of your professional responsibilities and limitations.
The ability to prioritize tasks and maintain a solution-oriented mindset.

What we offer:
Competitive salary packages and pension plans.
A permanent employment opportunity in a supportive and friendly environment.
A clear path for professional growth and development.
Free online Norwegian language courses with a private tutor to ease your transition.
Full assistance with obtaining Norwegian nursing authorization.
Comprehensive support with relocation logistics, including help with accommodation, schools, and childcare for your family.
Guidance from professional headhunters with 19 years of experience, who will assist you throughout the entire process.

Why choose Norway?
Norway is consistently ranked as one of the best countries in the world for quality of life. Our healthcare system is publicly funded, providing patients with excellent care while offering healthcare professionals a structured and rewarding work environment. 
Nurses in Norway benefit from clear career progression, strong support from interdisciplinary teams, and the ability to spend quality time with each patient, contributing to better health outcomes. In addition to professional growth, moving to Norway offers a chance to experience a high standard of living, with clean air, a focus on outdoor activities and a family-friendly environment.
If you see yourself thriving in this role and want to explore the possibilities of working in Norway, we encourage you to contact us. We look forward to guiding you through the next steps in your journey!

jobs.occupation: Internship in Refrigeration Circuit Engineering Department
jobs.description:
Company Description
Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells advanced heat pumps that harness energy from nature’s own resources – rock, water, and air.
In Tranås, you’ll find both our production unit and our competence and development center, where we constantly strive to stay at the forefront. Here we create smart solutions that simplify everyday life, contribute to a greener future, and provide our customers with safety and comfort

We believe in technology that makes a difference – technology that is Invented for life.

Job Description
Your contribution to something big
As part of this internship, you will engage in a diverse range of tasks, including:
Improving products by testing prototypes and/or serial appliances
Taking responsibility and contributing by coordinating project related topics
Supporting the team and development projects with analytical studies or simulations
Spreading and conserving knowledge by presenting and documenting test results or project findings
Involving yourself in research by studying and assessing new development ideas
Being creative and preparing or participating in development project related workshops

Duration of the internship: 6 months, preferably starting in March 2027
Location: on-site in our plant in Tranås, Sweden

Qualifications
What distinguishes you
Currently studying Mechanical Engineering or equivalent in the Bachelor's or Master's
Good written and verbal communication skills in English
Willingness to take on responsibility and drive work within your own initiative
Effective communication, teamwork abilities and comfortable working in an international team environment
Eagerness to learn and grow outside your field of studies
Strong logical reasoning and attention to detail
Critical thinking to analyze complex problems and dependencies
Knowledge in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics and refrigeration
Able to write engineering grade technical documentation
Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project)
Basic knowledge of Matlab/Simulink is an advantage

Additional Information
What we offer you
We offer monetary compensation to support you during your internship.
Free accommodation in Tranås is provided
To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services
We cover your travel costs from your residence to Tranås, making relocation easier for you
You gain valuable experience working within an international company with global connections

Welcome to Tranås – the heart of Bosch Home Comfort in Sweden
Tranås, beautifully located by the idyllic Lake Sommen and surrounded by forests and nature reserves, is home to Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Sweden. Here, more than 600 associates work in manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a sustainable future.
At Bosch, we care about you, our business, and the environment.
We offer more than a job – we help you grow in your career and as a person. Life is about balance, and we support your goals, whether they involve new challenges, development, or time for family and hobbies.
Join a workplace that values individuality, openness, and trust, where you can be yourself and be inspired by diverse perspectives from around the globe.
Join us in Tranås and be part of shaping tomorrow’s energy solutions – in a workplace where innovation meets quality of life.
Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch

jobs.occupation: Internship in Human Resources
jobs.description:

Welcome to a world, where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch!
Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 650 employees and form part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 417,000 employees worldwide.
We work with sustainable simplification of everyday life where the focus is on the environment, innovation, and development. In Tranås there is a production unit and a competence and development center. The heat pumps we manufacture draw energy from different sources - the mountain, the water, or the air. You will oversee the intern recruitment, from publishing job advertisements to conducting interviews
In addition to these tasks, you will also be responsible for your own project, process or reporting task

Currently studying Business Administration, Social Sciences, Psychology or similar, ideally with a focus on HR

At Bosch, we care for you, our business, and our environment. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid. We grow together into countless roles, positions, and opportunities and we are interested in developing the “whole” you, not just the “7 to 16” you, because life is all about balance.
At Bosch we understand that everyone has their own focus in life, whether it is about new professional challenges, training, and development, or more time for family, friends, and hobbies, whatever your goals are we are flexible. You will become part of a well-coordinated and skilled team consisting of doctors, psychologists, psychiatric nurses, social workers, occupational therapists, and medical secretaries who work closely together. You will meet patients with various degrees of mental illness, providing both independent assessments and collaborative treatment planning.

jobs.occupation: ROOF CLEANING TECHNICIAN
jobs.description:
TAKTEAM
SEASONAL 6-MONTH EMPLOYMENT 2027
ROOF CLEANING TECHNICIAN
Would you like to become part of a growing company that offers good opportunities for professional development while contributing to the sustainable maintenance and protection of our customers’ homes?
Then send your application today!
Candidate selection takes place on an ongoing basis.
JOB DESCRIPTION
As a member of our team, you will represent the company to our customers while carrying out the work. Most of the work takes place in different areas of Sweden, and you will be working outdoors, on the tiled roofs of residential properties.
Your duties will include cleaning tiled roofs and facades. This is a varied job involving many different activities and procedures. Overnight travel may also be required.
At the beginning of your employment, you will receive relevant training in the use of high-pressure cleaning equipment and in working at heights. Previous experience in these areas is, of course, an additional advantage.
The work takes place in different areas of Sweden, from the west coast to the east coast. This means that, alongside your work, you will have the opportunity to experience different parts of the country and discover Sweden from a different perspective.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
This is a physically demanding job that requires good physical ability and skill in using your body, hands, and various tools.
You will work in a two-person team responsible for roof cleaning. For this reason, we place great importance on your ability to cooperate and communicate effectively, accept and handle feedback, and, above all, be willing to work hard and pull your weight when needed.
If you have a colleague or friend who is also interested in coming to work in Sweden, we would be happy to know. The possibility of starting together can make it much easier to form a team, as two people usually work together in each team. In this way, if you come together, the team can be ready from the beginning.

• Good knowledge of Greek.
• Experience using high-pressure washing equipment, carpentry, roof installation/construction, or similar work involving machinery.
• Experience in the construction and assembly of scaffolding.
• Experience in cleaning and painting tiled roofs, as well as cleaning and painting facades.
WHAT DOES IT MEAN TO WORK AS A ROOF CLEANING TECHNICIAN AT TAKTEAM?
• A high level of freedom and responsibility in your work.
• Good opportunities for professional development.
• Variety in your daily work, with different types of tasks for our customers.
• Work in different areas of Sweden.
• Accommodation provided for the duration of your employment with us. Team members share the same apartment/accommodation.
• Statutory insurance coverage.
• Good benefits and working conditions.

jobs.occupation: Internship in Health, Safety & Environment Department
jobs.description:
Company Description

Welcome to a world, where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch!
Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 650 employees and form part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 417,000 employees worldwide.
We work with sustainable simplification of everyday life where the focus is on the environment, innovation, and development. In Tranås there is a production unit and a competence and development center. The heat pumps we manufacture draw energy from different sources - the mountain, the water, or the air. We work to constantly be at the forefront and contribute to sustainable energy and a better environment with the goal of creating a simplified everyday life for our customers. In short, we create technology that is "Invented for life".
About us
We support managers and executives in their environmental and working environment responsibilities. We comply with requirements according to laws and certifications as well as directives within the company group and communicate continuously internally.   

Job Description

Your contribution to something big
Our department drives the company's sustainability work, and your internship work will contribute to the implementation of local activities and initiatives in this area.
We also need to strengthen our team with an intern who is interested in environmental technology, has a basic understanding of ISO 14001 or similar standards.
The internship includes, among other things, environmental technology, waste management, chemical substances, reporting and project management.
We want you to have experience in problem solving, collecting and analyzing data, contributing to the development of training materials and work instructions.

Duration of the internship: 6 months, preferably starting February 2027
Location: on-site in our plant in Tranås, Sweden

Qualifications

What distinguishes you
You are an organizer, happy to take on projects and organize events in the area of sustainability.
Our company language is English, but we work on production projects and it would be beneficial if you could also communicate in Swedish, so a basic knowledge of Swedish is an advantage.
Ongoing studies in Industrial Engineering and Management, Sustainability Management, Safety & Environmental Engineering, or a related field.
Knowledge and experience of Microsoft Office 365 with a special emphasis on Word Excel and PowerPoint.
Good communication skills, both verbal and written.
Problem solving skills.
Please note: Only applications from students that are currently studying are accepted.

Additional Information

What we offer you
Monetary compensation is included to support you during your internship
We can offer free accommodation in Tranås
To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services
We cover your travel costs from your residence to Tranås, making relocation easier for you
You gain valuable experience working within an international company with global connections

jobs.occupation: We seek nurses for permanent positions in Snåsa in Norway
jobs.description:
Would you like a permanent nursing position with varied responsibilities and nature right outside your door?
On behalf of Snåsa Municipality in Trøndelag, Norway, we are seeking three registered nurses for permanent positions within the municipal healthcare and care services.
Here, you will enjoy a varied and meaningful workday, providing care and follow-up for patients both in home care services and in institutional settings. You will become part of a professional healthcare environment where nurses play a key role, with a high degree of autonomy, varied clinical responsibilities, and close collaboration with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
At the same time, you will have the opportunity to live in a place where nature is never far away. Snåsa is located next to the Blåfjella-Skjækerfjella National Park, offering vast forests, mountains, and excellent opportunities for hiking, cycling, hunting, and fishing. With a population of approximately 2,100 people, Snåsa is also a welcoming community where it is easy to get to know people and feel at home.
About the position
As a Registered Nurse, you will have a varied workday caring for patients with different needs in both home care services and institutional care settings.
Typical responsibilities include:
Providing daily nursing care and professional follow-up to patients in home care services and/or institutional care
Observing, assessing, and documenting patients’ health conditions
Medication administration and treatment in accordance with applicable guidelines and regulations
Collaborating with other healthcare professionals, family members, and multidisciplinary teams
Contributing to quality improvement initiatives and the development of local routines and patient care pathways

The position involves shift work, including day, evening, and weekend shifts. You will have a significant level of professional responsibility and will work both independently and closely with other professional groups. High-quality, safe patient care is at the heart of everything, while maintaining a positive working environment built on collaboration, well-being, and good humor.
Qualifications
We are looking for someone who is professionally engaged, responsible, and enjoys working both independently and as part of a team.
Authorization as a registered nurse in an EU or EEA country
Good communication skills in English and willingness to learn Norwegian
Valid police clearance and health certificate including tuberculosis and MRSA before starting
Valid driver’s licence (Class B)
Professionally engaged and responsible
Strong teamwork and adaptability skills
Experience from elderly care, home care services, or rehabilitation is an advantage

We offer
Permanent employment with competitive terms and conditions
Free Norwegian language training provided
A stable and predictable working environment
Varied and meaningful nursing responsibilities
A supportive and collaborative team environment, including guidance when needed
Excellent opportunities for professional development and continuing education
Attractive municipal pension and insurance schemes through KLP
Additional compensation for evening, night, and weekend work
Support and follow-up from Dignus Medical throughout the application and employment process
Support with housing and relocation when needed

Life in Snåsa
Snåsa is located in the northern part of Trøndelag, along the E6 highway and the Nordland Railway, approximately 50 minutes from Steinkjer. The municipality has around 2,100 residents and is ideal for those who wish to live close to nature while being part of a small and welcoming community. The area offers an active sports and cultural scene, shops, cafés, and excellent opportunities for outdoor activities all year round.
For those relocating with family, the municipality offers good capacity in kindergartens, schools, and after-school programs, as well as a variety of leisure activities for children and families. Trondheim Airport Værnes is approximately two hours away by car, and the Nordland Railway also provides convenient transportation to and from Snåsa.
Interested?
Feel free to contact us for more information or submit a short application today!
